conventions.qubit_order: qubit q = region qubit_to_region[q] (identity unless stated); Qiskit count keys: the RIGHTMOST character is qubit 0
conventions.bit_meaning: bit 1 = region on device B (GPU / second CPU), bit 0 = device A; state index k has bit r = region r
conventions.alpha: target work share of device B per scenario (0.5 equal devices, 0.8 CPU + GPU)
conventions.qaoa: H (or RY(theta) warm start); per layer rzz(2 gamma J_ij) over zz_pairs, rz(2 gamma h_i), mixer rx(-2 beta) or warm RY-RZ-RY
conventions.rebuild: qollab/mesh_ionq.circuit_from_spec(spec); verified to reproduce the notebook distribution to < 1e-9

selection_rule:
(fixed here, before looking at IonQ): the p = 0 control (one circuit, graded under both scenarios) plus, per
scenario, the two highest crude-estimate P(optimum) circuits with at most MAX_2Q two-qubit gates; at most one of the two may
start from a classical answer (warm start); 'initial state only' controls are not candidates. Fallback (one circuit per job):
the highest crude-estimate P(optimum) circuit that does not start from a classical answer. Optional extra: the varQITE ZY
circuit trained for CPU + GPU, which Lemma 1 of the report predicts to fail (the demonstration of the main finding).

circuits.name: p = 0 control (uniform)
circuits.role: p = 0 control (uniform guessing; the same circuit is graded under both scenarios)

circuits.name: varQITE ZY (paper, all pairs)
circuits.role: 2 equal devices: best #1 by crude estimate (<= 200 two-qubit gates)

circuits.name: varQITE A (all pairs)
circuits.role: 2 equal devices: best #2 by crude estimate (<= 200 two-qubit gates)

circuits.name: warm-start QAOA (rounded spectral, mixer B), fixed: recovery angles, p = 1
circuits.role: CPU + GPU (GPU 4x): best #1 by crude estimate (<= 200 two-qubit gates)

spec.note: rounded warm start with the modified mixer (Egger et al., Sec. 2.3); started from the complement because the problem has fields (our adaptation)

circuits.name: CVaR-QAOA + SPSA, p = 2
circuits.role: CPU + GPU (GPU 4x): best #2 by crude estimate (<= 200 two-qubit gates)

extras.name: varQITE ZY (paper, all pairs)
extras.role: optional extra: Lemma 1 demonstration (varQITE ZY trained for CPU + GPU; predicted to fail)

fallback.name: varQITE ZY (paper, all pairs)
fallback.role: fallback: the single circuit to run if IonQ accepts only one circuit per job
